primary_result.finding: Keep the dense input embedding resident on GPU in GPU-exclusive full-offload mode, eliminating the repeated approximately 1030.62 MiB full-table host-to-device copy.
primary_result.memory_tradeoff: Sampled managed CUDA allocation increases by 585389824 bytes (558.27 MiB), while remaining below the 12 GiB managed quota. This is not a footprint-neutral change.

methodology.source_paths: Repository-relative only; raw prompts, generated text, UUIDs, local absolute paths and raw environments are omitted.
methodology.rounds_per_prompt_and_variant: Three in A/B/C/D; two in E (one runner-cold and one warm).
methodology.prompts: Two fixed natural-prose tasks in A/B/C/D, 55 and 506 observed tokens. E repeats the long task ten times for 4961 observed tokens; raw prompts omitted.
methodology.cold: Fresh server and runner; OS file cache and device/compiler caches were not flushed.
methodology.warm: Repeated identical prompt within a runner; 51 short, 502 long or 4957 growth-test prompt tokens cached.
methodology.warm_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of captured warm per-request token rates, reported separately for each prompt; E has only one warm sample.
methodology.throughput: API eval_count divided by eval_duration; decode_steps_s also records (eval_count - 1) divided by the same duration.
methodology.isolation: Separate laboratory model store using verified hardlinks to the same model weights; isolated server port; production service/store not modified by the benchmark.
methodology.guardrails: Native logical context and API loaded-model context checked; fit disabled, all layers requested on GPU, strict CUDA-heavy-op enforcement, 12 GiB managed quota and at least 4 GiB system free-RAM stop guard.
methodology.cuda_managed_memory: Maximum sampled native allocator activity value for the runner, including model, KV, recurrent and graph allocations; excludes display, driver and other processes. Samples are not a dedicated allocator-peak counter.
methodology.nvml_memory: Device-wide used memory sampled by NVML, including every process, display and driver allocation; not the runner's quota or model residency.
methodology.process_working_set: Sum of working sets for the observed laboratory process tree; shared pages can be counted multiple times, so this is not unique physical RAM.
methodology.process_private_commit: Sum of PrivateUsage commit charge for the process tree; can include nonresident/driver-mapped pages and is not physical RAM or CPU model-weight residency.
methodology.buffer_component_precision: Native buffer components are logged in rounded MiB; managed allocation snapshots are integer bytes.
limitations: Short, nonstatistical single-machine runs; no confidence interval or sustained-throughput claim.
No GPU clock, power, temperature, utilization or transfer profiler was active in these benchmark captures.

Requested capacity is 131072 tokens; A/B/C/D exercise55/506 prompt tokens and128 generated tokens. E exercises4961 prompt tokens and32 generated tokens. None is a full-context throughput or quality test.
A and B were recorded before the input-embedding placement correction and must not be used as the final corrected runtime's speed claim.
Identical captured output is evidence for these deterministic samples, not a general language-quality or all-model equivalence guarantee.
Captured thinking is empty in these runs; equality of empty thinking fields does not evaluate hidden reasoning quality.
Cold load/TTFT depends on OS/device cache order and is not attributed entirely to code changes.
Resource samples can miss transient peaks; the system free-RAM stop guard is not a hard per-process RAM limit.
D2 predates the corrected gated-normalization matcher. D3 uses the final CUDA hash, but its long baseline is unusually low and does not establish a general15.6percent benefit; dense_opt remains off.

comparisons.purpose: Dense GPU-exclusive full offload: place the input embedding table on CUDA at model load, avoiding its repeated full-table host-to-device copy.
comparisons.attribution: Both switches stay off (dense_opt=0; kv_cache_initial_tokens=0). Payload versions differ; this is the integrated corrected placement path, not an isolated kernel-only comparison.

comparisons.purpose: Same final payload: dense_opt0 versus1, KV commitment disabled. The corrected subgraph matcher can now activate gated normalization fusion.
comparisons.attribution: Two warm repetitions per prompt. The long baseline is lower than earlier41-44tokens/s controls; observed differences are not a causal or universal fusion speedup.
comparisons.recommendation: Keep dense_opt disabled by default. Short changes are near noise; the larger long change has a depressed baseline and too few repetitions for a robust causal claim.

comparisons.purpose: Same corrected payload, dense kernel switch 0 versus 1, KV commitment disabled.
comparisons.attribution: Kernel ablation after removing the dominant PCIe bottleneck.
comparisons.recommendation: Historical result only: experimental switch regressed in this earlier build. Use D3 for the final matcher's captured ablation; default remains disabled.
comparisons.historical_scope: Shared-input quantization/reuse could execute, but the linear-chain matcher rejected the gated-normalization DAG. These timings do not measure the final corrected normalization fusion.

comparisons.purpose: Real Qwen prompt beyond initial KV commitment, same payload and logical context.
comparisons.attribution: Same corrected payload, dense_opt=0; initial commitment 0 versus 256 tokens; prompt4961 tokens exceeds initial commitment and physical allocation grows.

physical_growth_evidence.scope: Initial KV MiB is logged directly. Final KV MiB is inferred from the managed-allocation delta after subtracting matching baseline scratch growth; it is not a separate KV-residency counter.

comparisons.purpose: Same payload and dense_opt=0; initial physical KV commitment 0 (full allocation) versus 8192 tokens.
comparisons.attribution: Memory result is useful; throughput was dominated by the later-corrected embedding transfer.

comparisons.purpose: Earlier and new payloads with dense kernel switch 0 versus 1; KV commitment disabled.
comparisons.attribution: Different payloads and the dominant embedding-transfer bottleneck prevent attributing small timing differences solely to kernel changes.

diagnostic_template_count.scope: Functional equality of token counts for the captured template case; not a performance or general tokenizer-equivalence claim.

final_qwen_diagnostic.scope: Actual Qwen executes all three traced paths. Printed counters are capped diagnostic observations, not total model invocation counts. Diagnostic timing is excluded from performance comparisons.

dense_cuda_opt0.scope: CPU-reference, replay and fallback checks; positive submissions verify the eligible GPU fusion really executed.

dense_cuda_opt1.scope: CPU-reference, replay and fallback checks; positive submissions verify the eligible GPU fusion really executed.

latest_payload_validation.historical_scope: C remains the primary placement comparison on its captured earlier binary. A/B/C/D2/E records and hashes are historical and were not rerun or retroactively relabeled as final-binary measurements.
latest_payload_validation.interpretation: The final OPT0 control remains approximately44tokens/s short and38tokens/s long in this capture; earlier long controls were41-44. No clocks/power/utilization profiler or statistical repetition establishes the source of this variation.
